bio:
Petro Land Ventures is a small firm by design. Rickey Matherne, Jr., CPL and Shannon Matherne, CPL both hold the Certified Professional Landman designation from the American Association of Professional Landmen, and both work files themselves. There is no junior bench for work to be handed down to, and no account manager sitting between you and the person actually reading the record.

The firm works with operators, exploration companies, independent producers, mineral and royalty owners, and institutional investors. Engagements run from single-tract curative work to multi-county leasing programs, A&D packages, and portfolio-scale due diligence — and the same two people handle all of it.
approach:
Thoroughness in this business is mostly a matter of not stopping early. The defect that matters is rarely the one in the first three deeds; it is the one four conveyances back, in a probate that was never filed where you would expect it.

So the work runs to the end of the chain. When something is unclear, it gets flagged as unclear rather than smoothed over — you will know exactly what was found, what it means, and what your options are. Reports are written to be handed to counsel, to a lender, or to a buyer's diligence team without needing a translator.

That standard applies to every project, regardless of size.
